name: On event
description: A skeleton for reacting to an event: read its fields as untrusted data and write only the outputs you allow (a report, a task, a message to the owner). It runs on Run now; the event trigger and an hourly fire cap come with events in a later version. Pull requests and deletions need an approval step that arrives in a later version; until then this only reports and files tasks.
